name: The Rat King
guide_text: Hero power the first 6 turns (except turn 2), and be tavern 4 by turn 6. Then, you don't have to hero power every turn, only when the tribe is useful to you.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up for 0. Use it for some free rolls in the midgame. Golden buddy is useless so feel free to sell it as a cycle spot and replay it in the future.
